summary: This directory centralizes the definition of structured knowledge schemas designed for LLM consumption. It provides a consistent format for documenting package mission, technical requirements, operational guidelines, and development roadmaps.
responsibilities: Defining structured formats for project-level information
Providing schemas for technical installation and integration data
Managing developer-facing operational knowledge and FAQs
Tracking feature roadmap and project development status
relationships: The Package schema acts as a container for high-level documentation, while Technical and Development schemas provide granular details for implementation and usage.
Roadmap items provide context for future development that can be referenced within the broader Package knowledge structure.
Technical reference schemas define the prerequisites and environmental constraints required for successful package adoption.
designDecisions: Use of TypeScript const objects to enforce schema structure
Separation of concerns between high-level package rationale and low-level technical reference
Centralized export strategy for easy access to all knowledge types
